policy: Every v1.1 definition that reuses a v1 name (core or billing), and every v1.1 capability body that overrides a v1 body, is listed here. Each one is a replacement, not compatible with the v1 shape in either direction; writers emit only the current shape. Checked by inspectDeclaredReplacements in scripts/boundary-checks.mjs.

changes.name: ads.campaign.pause.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: executes without a second approver, so the v1 proposalRef/approvalRef input is replaced by named campaigns plus a recorded reason and optional source proposal.

changes.name: agents.installation.disable.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: a stop is an idempotent target state, so expectedRevision is dropped and a recorded reason plus optional source proposal is required.

changes.name: governance.membership.revoke.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: a stop is an idempotent target state, so expectedRevision is dropped and a recorded reason plus optional source proposal is required.

changes.name: governance.connection.disconnect.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: a stop is an idempotent target state, so expectedRevision is dropped and a recorded reason plus optional source proposal is required.

changes.name: agents.release.revoke.input
changes.reason: Kill switch: control.reason replaces the v1 free-text reason and adds an optional source proposal.

changes.name: Proposal
changes.reason: Proposal@2: schemaVersion 2; per-target and total credit and cash ceilings inside the digest; server-derived irreversible, requestedBy, beneficiaries and contextTaint; partial approval and derivation. A v1 proposal is not a valid Proposal@2.

changes.name: Approval
changes.reason: Approval@2: schemaVersion 2; a human reviewer only; the bound review policy, quorum, recorded decisions and effectiveAt. A v1 approval is not a valid Approval@2.

changes.name: governance.approval.decide.input
changes.reason: The decision becomes a ReviewDecisionInput bound to the exact proposal digest, with an optional target selection, solo-owner confirmation and cancel before effect, in place of the v1 DecisionRef.

changes.name: BillingAccount
changes.reason: BillingAccount@2: schemaVersion 2; a route and a mode; a Morrow-direct account is storeless (installationId and storeId null, never uninstalled), so the shop-only v1 account cannot represent it. A v1 account is not a valid BillingAccount@2.

changes.name: EntitlementSnapshot
changes.reason: EntitlementSnapshot@2: schemaVersion 2; a route and a mode; subscriptionId holds a route-matched SubscriptionKey; installation and store follow the account's rule.

changes.name: CreditGrant
changes.reason: CreditGrant@2: schemaVersion 2; a route, a mode and the PaymentKey that makes a grant unique per (route, mode, paymentKey); a Shopify grant is always included.

changes.name: AllocationShare
changes.reason: AllocationShare@2: installationId and storeId are both null for a storeless Morrow-direct payer, or both set for a Shopify payer; v1 required both.
